title: Faster screens
thisBuild: Tapping pads no longer rebuilds the whole screen, so the grid should feel quicker.
The step grid and the roll redraw only the playhead while playing.
The bug panel now shows how smooth the screen is and how hard the sound engine works, and every note carries those numbers.
watch: Drum on the pads and switch tabs while a loop plays. Still slow? Send a Tuning note from the 🐞 button right after, so the speed numbers go with it.
limits: No performance effects yet (stutter, tape stop, echo, crush and the rest).
No importing your own sounds or recording from the mic yet.
Chop to pads and fit to tempo from the doctor's table are not in yet.
It stops playing a while after you leave the app.
